task: Close the R410 gap identified in the #819 review by checking OpenBao and Headlamp bootstrap Helm chart pins against GitOps targetRevision.

Before adding the guard, R410 accepted independent in-memory bootstrap-only bumps from OpenBao 0.28.3 to 0.29.0 and Headlamp 0.46.0 to 0.47.0. With the mutations added before the fix, --mutation-verify stopped at FAIL: mutation not rejected: openbao bootstrap chart bumped.

R410 keeps the GitOps chart pins and requires each named bootstrap Helm command to supply one matching --version. Added a bootstrap-only version mutation for each release and updated the regression description and both root changelogs.
